## `measure`

Return one bounded report; positive offset means ECN time is ahead.

```python
async def measure(*, samples: int = 3, timeout: float | None = None) -> ClockReport
```

### Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| samples | int | 3 | Number of NTP samples to attempt, from 1 through 10. The report describes the valid sample with the lowest round-trip delay. |
| timeout | float \| None | None | Whole-measurement timeout in seconds, greater than 0 through 60. `None` uses the client's configured operation timeout. |

### Returns

| Type | Description |
| --- | --- |
| ClockReport | One completed measurement of ECN time minus local time. |

### Raises

| Exception | Description |
| --- | --- |
| NotReadyError | If the client is closed. |
| ResourceLimitError | If another measurement is already active. |
| TimeoutError | If the measurement exceeds `timeout`. |
| ClockError | If the endpoint cannot be measured. |
| ClockProtocolError | If no usable NTP response is obtained. |
| ValidationError | If `samples` or `timeout` is out of range. |

[Source · interfaces/clock.py](https://github.com/picogrid/ecn-sdk-python/blob/v0.1.0/src/picogrid_ecn_client/interfaces/clock.py#L36)

## `require_within`

Return a report or raise unless offset plus local uncertainty is within.

```python
async def require_within(
    *,
    max_offset_seconds: float,
    samples: int = 3,
    timeout: float | None = None,
) -> ClockReport
```

### Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| max_offset_seconds | float | — | Absolute tolerance in seconds, from 0 through 86,400. The check compares the absolute offset plus the local capture uncertainty against this bound. |
| samples | int | 3 | Number of NTP samples to attempt, from 1 through 10. |
| timeout | float \| None | None | Whole-measurement timeout in seconds, greater than 0 through 60. `None` uses the client's configured operation timeout. |

### Returns

| Type | Description |
| --- | --- |
| ClockReport | The completed measurement, whose `within_tolerance` is true. |

### Raises

| Exception | Description |
| --- | --- |
| NotReadyError | If the client is closed. |
| ClockToleranceError | If the measurement exceeds the tolerance; the error carries the report. |
| ResourceLimitError | If another measurement is already active. |
| TimeoutError | If the measurement exceeds `timeout`. |
| ClockError | If the endpoint cannot be measured. |
| ClockProtocolError | If no usable NTP response is obtained. |
| ValidationError | If an argument is out of range. |
